What this guide shows

Ten short animations, one per step of the Lab 2 instruction sheet. Each one is a schematic drawing of the screen you will see — not a recording of a specific computer — so that the step is readable on any system. The exact wording of menus can differ from one version to another; the footnote under each animation says what may look different. Everything is current as of September–October 2026.

  • Read the instruction sheet first (420-1C2-DW_Lab2_Threat_Catalogue_Instructions.pdf); keep the quick guide next to you.
  • Steps 1 (installing) is not animated: it is the normal installer of Python 3.15.1 (tick Add python.exe to PATH) and of LibreOffice 26.8 if you do not have Excel.
  • The animations loop; the download button under each one saves the GIF for offline use.

1Step 3 — Download the workbook and the checker files from the Class 5 module

In the lecture module, open the section Reference tables, code and downloads. Download the Excel workbook (reference tables + Lab 2 templates), the script kalmia_threat_catalogue.py and the three data files assets.csv, facts.csv, incidents.csv. Rename the workbook Lab2_Kalmia_Catalogue_Lastname.xlsx and move it to catalogue/; move the four other files to checker/.

1 Browser download bars differ (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari); the files land in your Downloads folder unless you changed the setting. Browser versions of September 2026 ask no question for these file types.

2Step 2 — Create the folder and write README.txt

Open PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (macOS / Linux) and create the five folders with one command. Write README.txt at the top of the folder: course and lab title, your name and student number, the date, your sources, your tools and the integrity statement, exactly: I used fictional lab data only.

2 On Windows 11 (25H2, September 2026) the terminal application is Windows Terminal running PowerShell 7 or Windows PowerShell 5.1 — the mkdir command is the same in both. Notepad on Windows 11 saves UTF-8 by default.

3Step 4 — Fill the source register (8 to 12 sources)

Sheet Lab2_Source_Register: one row per public source you follow for Kalmia — family, publisher, document or feed, official address, cadence, reliability letter A–F, what you take from it, the Lab 1 assets it covers. The three yellow rows are examples. Check every address on VirusTotal before you open it.

3 The screens show LibreOffice Calc 26.8 / Excel for Microsoft 365 (September 2026). Sheet tabs are at the bottom in both; Google Sheets puts them at the bottom too but names the export menu File › Download.

4Step 5 — Keep the watch list (at least 8 dated items)

Sheet Lab2_Watch_List: one line per item read between October 15 and November 13, 2026 — date, publisher, family, title, products, severity, matched assets, decision (drop-down list), reference, rating, note. Discarded items keep their line with the rating.

4 The drop-down list of the Decision column is a data validation; in Google Sheets it appears after the file is imported, in Numbers it does not — type the value exactly in that case.

5Step 6 — Write the catalogue rows (at least 25, fifteen columns)

Sheet Lab2_Threat_Catalogue: one row = one threat event in the four-part form (source + action + asset + means). Fill the identity columns, the three scores and the facts matched; the Relevance column fills itself; the evidence column starts with the fact codes; the reference carries its date and rating. Watch the sheet Lab2_Checks.

5 The relevance formula is an ordinary spreadsheet formula (IF / AND / OR): it recalculates in Excel, LibreOffice, Gnumeric and Google Sheets. Do not type into column L.

6Step 6 (end) — Export the three sheets as CSV UTF-8

Each sheet is exported separately: File › Save As, type CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited) in Excel or Text CSV with character set Unicode (UTF-8) in LibreOffice, into catalogue/csv/. Answer Yes to the warning about lost features: it concerns the export only. Your .xlsx file stays intact.

6 Excel exports only the active sheet. A French-Canadian Windows writes semicolons instead of commas — the checker accepts both. In Google Sheets: File › Download › Comma-separated values.

7Step 7 — Build the ATT&CK map in the Navigator

Open the ATT&CK Navigator in the browser, create a new Enterprise layer (version 20), search each technique of your adversarial rows, select it, colour it by relevance level, name the layer, then export the layer as JSON and render it to SVG. Both go to attack/ with your half-page note.

7 Navigator screens of September 2026 (version 5.x): the toolbar icons are at the top right of the layer tab. Later versions may move the icons or propose a newer ATT&CK version by default — keep v20 for this lab so that your identifiers match Class 5.

8Step 8 — Run the checker, fix what it reports, run it again

In the terminal, go to checker/ and run the command of the instruction sheet; it writes checker_report.txt. Each of the six rules says PASS or FAIL with the identifiers concerned. Fix the workbook, export the CSV again, run again, until the last line reads RESULT: READY TO SUBMIT.

8 Windows: python; macOS and Linux: python3. Python 3.15.1 (October 2026) is the version used in class; any Python 3.11 or later runs the script. If Windows opens the Microsoft Store instead of Python, re-run the installer and tick Add python.exe to PATH.

9Step 9 — Write the one-page memo and export it to PDF

One page to Nadia Roy in business language: the five High rows (what could happen, to which asset, why we think so), the three open supplier questions and the decision you ask for. Identifiers go in a footnote. Export to PDF into memo/.

9 Writer 26.8: File › Export as PDF; Word for Microsoft 365: File › Save As › PDF (or Export); Pages: File › Export To › PDF.

10Step 9 (end) — Compress the folder and submit it in the Léa drop box

Right-click the folder and compress it to one ZIP named exactly like the folder. On Omnivox, open Léa › 420-1C2-DW Threats and Risks › Assignments (Travaux) › Lab 2 — Threat catalogue › Submit, choose the ZIP, confirm, and keep the confirmation. Deadline: Saturday, November 14, 2026, 23:59 Eastern Time.

10 The Omnivox / Léa layout of the autumn 2026 session is shown schematically; menu names may appear in French (Travaux, Remettre). The drop box closes automatically at the deadline.

Before you press Submit

  • ≥ 25 rows · four-part events · asset codes · techniques · scores · evidence with fact codes · dated references with ratings
  • Coverage: actor profiles, insider types, non-adversarial families, INC-01–05, F01–F12, critical assets
  • 8–12 sources · ≥ 8 dated watch-list items · Navigator JSON + image + note · checker READY TO SUBMIT · one-page memo · README with the integrity statement · one ZIP
